note: Preferences (layer 13): how the app shows things. One line each: id, label, hint, kind, options [value, words], default, and where it is saved (browser unless noted). ui/prefs.js reads this list; ui/prefs-screen.js draws one control per line.

prefs.label: Show money as
prefs.hint: Dollars, or what each amount costs in hours of work or in days of FI pushed later. Every screen follows it.

prefs.label: Hide numbers
prefs.hint: For screen sharing or in public: amounts blur until you tap them.

prefs.label: Round amounts
prefs.hint: On summary screens (Home, Numbers totals). Show the math and the log keep cents.

prefs.label: Theme
prefs.hint: Light, dark, or whatever this device is set to.

prefs.label: Text size
prefs.hint: Larger makes every screen easier to read.

prefs.label: Default time window
prefs.hint: What Spending and the Calendar open on; each can still change it.

prefs.label: Tone
prefs.hint: How nudges are worded. It never changes a number.

prefs.label: What Today shows
prefs.hint: Pick the tiles and their order.

prefs.label: Coach view or client view
prefs.hint: Client view hides the Builder links and the coach's own tools.
